chip.description: 16-bit 8086-instruction-set processor (uPD70136) from the NEC V-series, roughly twice the throughput of the V30 at the same clock. Main CPU of the Irem M92 and M107 boards.
chip.notes: Part number from the V5x device table in src/devices/cpu/v5x.cpp (MAME 0.288), which lists "V53 (uPD70236) -- V33 (uPD70136)". Board usage from src/mame/irem/m107.cpp ("V33(config, m_maincpu, XTAL(28'000'000) / 2); // NEC V33, 28MHz clock") and src/mame/irem/m92.cpp.
